zh-CN.title: 聊天在线状态
items: 聊天页会自动刷新在线状态。停止活动两分钟后显示离线。
修复 iOS 聊天中小兜分享卡片宽度不一、类型标签换行的问题

en.title: Online status in chat
items: Chat refreshes online status automatically and shows users as offline after two minutes without activity.
Pocklo share cards use a consistent width and keep the resource type on one line in iOS chat.
